# Toxoplasma PV v3 (round 6)

`toxoplasma_pv_v3` · Cellpose-SAM (cpsam_v2) · older version in the `toxoplasma_pv` family

The family's default is [toxoplasma_pv_v4](toxoplasma_pv_v4.md).

Other versions: [toxoplasma_pv_v5](toxoplasma_pv_v5.md) (alternative), [toxoplasma_pv_v4](toxoplasma_pv_v4.md), [toxoplasma_pv_v2](toxoplasma_pv_v2.md), [toxoplasma_pv_v1](toxoplasma_pv_v1.md).

## Training data

The 556 curated PV fields of round 5, split 437 train / 108 validation / 11 test; training data at einarolafsson/toxoplasma-pv-segmentation-dataset.

Toxoplasma tachyzoite parasitophorous vacuoles stained with goat anti-Toxoplasma-biotin, and tachyzoites expressing DsRed in the PV lumen (RH and ME49). Round 6 retrains round 5's data with cellpose 4.2.1.1, 100 epochs, base cpsam_v2.

## Notes

- NEWEST IS NOT BEST HERE: round 6 does not beat round 2 on the anchor wells -- 0.8602 against 0.8648 -- and the PV project still promotes round 5.
- It is the first PV round whose checkpoint was chosen on a held-out validation set (108 fields) instead of on the test wells.
- 5-fold cross-validation, grouped by source: F1 0.8168 +/- 0.028, AJI 0.7516, Dice 0.8424.
- The 11 anchor wells have been held out since round 1, so they are the only fields no PV round has ever trained on.
- Re-scored 2026-10-11 on curated ground truth (spaCR pipeline call, defaults; receipt features/data/model_rescore_curated_gt_2026-10-11/receipt.json): strict hold-out, fields this model never saw, F1 0.750 at IoU 0.5 on n = 269 of 655 fields (n differs between models); common subset unseen by every pv model, n = 163, F1 0.790 (95% bootstrap CI 0.726 to 0.835). Without the 98 paged round-3 fields (n = 65): F1 0.754. Earlier numbers in this row are superseded by this re-score where they differ. Default unchanged.

## How to read these scores

- **Precision** is the share of objects the model reported that match a reference object; low precision means false detections. **Recall** is the share of reference objects the model found; low recall means missed objects.
- **F1** is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, so it is high only when both are. Either alone can look near-perfect: a model that reports one obvious object has high precision, and one that reports every dark blob has high recall.
- **IoU** (intersection over union) is the overlap between a predicted and a reference object divided by the area the two cover together. A score given at IoU 0.5 counts an object as found when that ratio reaches 0.5.
- **AJI** (aggregated Jaccard index) adds up the overlap of every matched pair and divides it by their combined area plus the area of unmatched objects, so merged, split and missed objects all lower it.
- **Dice** is twice the overlap divided by the predicted area plus the reference area.
- **Stock** is the base model named under Architecture, run without fine-tuning on the same images. **Difference** is this model's score minus stock's.
- **Cross-validated** scores split the data into folds, hold out each fold once and report the mean over folds with its standard deviation (**SD**, or +/-). A single split can mislead; the SD shows how far the score moves from one split to another.
- A **hold-out** or **test** set is images kept out of training and used only for scoring. The re-score note says how many of its fields this model had not seen.
